name: argentina-cross-border
description: Use this Guide for Argentina cross-border income tax in fiscal year 2026: beneficiarios del exterior, retenciones al exterior, residencia fiscal, convenios de doble imposicion, establecimiento permanente, tax residence, foreign tax credits and SIRE F.997. It covers resident worldwide versus non-resident Argentine-source taxation, ordinary outbound payment presumptions, withholding and gross-up, residence changes, permanent establishments, treaty documentation under RG 5855/2026 and foreign tax credit limitations. It prepares a documented tax-classification working paper for professional review. It does not give country-specific treaty rates, foreign exchange permissions, securities exemptions, indirect transfer computations, customs or a complete imported-service VAT return.
